title: New-Charge Months on Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Arrangement Revisions
content:
**Schedule.** New-charge months are added to the remaining term of a revised Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility arrangement according to the patient charges posted on the account since the arrangement began. A charge counts when it was posted fewer whole calendar months before the handling date than the installments fallen due — the whole calendar months from the arrangement's start date to the handling date, plus one.

| Total of the charges counted | Months added |
|---|---|
| at least 300.00 | 2 |
| at least 100.00 but less than 300.00 | 1 |
| less than 100.00 | 0 |

**Which charges count (hypothetical).** An arrangement started 4 whole calendar months before the handling date has 5 installments fallen due; a charge posted 4 whole months before the handling date counts, one posted 5 whole months before does not.

**Totals at the edges (hypothetical).** 300.00 adds 2; 299.99 adds 1; 100.00 adds 1; 99.99 adds none.
